chats.batch_source: client clock per request (sent after a barrier, each text delta's arrival, end; the monitor's clock) and engine predicted_n and predicted_ms (scripts/capacity/batchlib.py): a request's decode span is [end - predicted_ms, end], the engine's own first-token-to-last-token duration ending at the client end (the first visible delta is not used, because gpt-oss harmony tokens are not streamed); W is the window in which every request decodes, tokens inside W are the text deltas that arrive in it (basis token_times; even_spread spreads predicted_n - 1 over the decode span when delta times are missing), and SSD reads are counted once over W; the per-request rows above are per sequence (each request's engine timings), not throughput
